requirements: R1: The system must automatically update archive access based on Moodle course enrollments and departments

slices.title: Patch Moodle Profile Sync for Course Enrollment
slices.jtbd: When implementing the background sync update for this epic, I want to fetch and update the user's courses and department, so that the archive access automatically matches the Moodle enrollment state.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given a scheduled Moodle sync job
When it fetches user profiles
Then it must synchronize the user's courses and department in addition to their role
And integration tests must verify the correct synchronization across layers
slices.sixSigmaMetric: percent of users with perfectly synchronized enrollments

requirements: R1: The system must automatically suspend local archive accounts when the corresponding Moodle account is suspended or deleted

slices.title: Patch Moodle Sync for Local Account Suspension
slices.jtbd: When implementing the background sync update for this epic, I want to detect suspended or deleted Moodle accounts, so that the corresponding local fallback accounts are disabled.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given a user with a local fallback password
When their Moodle account is suspended or deleted
Then the background sync detects the suspension and disables the local user account
And unit tests must verify the suspension logic correctly toggles account status
slices.sixSigmaMetric: percent of suspended Moodle accounts with correctly disabled local accounts
